summary: Participium is a web application for the Municipality of Turin enabling citizens to report urban issues (e.g., potholes, trash) via an interactive map and form. Reports undergo a lifecycle: Pending Approval -> Assigned (to technical offices or external maintainers) -> In Progress -> Resolved/Rejected/Suspended. The system supports anonymous reporting, internal communication between staff/maintainers, public/private statistics, Telegram bot integration for reporting and notifications, and account management.

requirements.text:
As an unregistered user
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: See similar story for citizen
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to assign reports to external maintainers
So that specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention.
constraints: It can be possible for specific reports of certain categories (e.g., Enel X for category Public Lighting) based on their content reviewed by the technical office staff member.
expected_behaviors: specialized maintainers can handle and update the intervention

requirements.text:
As an external maintainer 
I want to update the status of a report assigned to me
So that I can updated citizens about  the intervention.
expected_behaviors: I can updated citizens about  the intervention

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member/external maintainer
I want to exchange information and comments on the report internally
So that coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens
expected_behaviors: coordination happens without exposing internal notes to citizens

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to register with my name and username 
So that I can access the Participium system and submit reports.
constraints: Registration is required before submitting reports.
expected_behaviors: I can access the Participium system and submit reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to confirm my registration with a code
So that my account becomes valid and I can start using the system.
constraints: Once a registration is completed, the user gets an email with a confirmation code. The person can use the application only after confirming by entering the code valid for 30 minutes.
expected_behaviors: my account becomes valid and I can start using the system

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to set up municipality users
constraints: These are the internal accounts of the municipality

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to assign roles to municipality users
constraints: Possible roles: municipal public relations officer, municipal administrator, technical office staff member, external maintainer. You can be more specific on technical offices to run realisti scenarios following the official organizational structure of the municipality of Turin (https://trasparenza.comune.torino.it/media/2212/download)

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to select a location on the city map
So that my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude.
constraints: Reports must be tied to a specific location. Use OpenStreet Map (or any other derivative map based on it), standard layer
expected_behaviors: my report is geolocated with latitude and longitude

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to provide details for my report 
So that the the problem is classified correctly.
constraints: Mandatory fields: title, description,  category , photos (min 1 max 3).
expected_behaviors: the the problem is classified correctly

requirements.text:
As a municipal public relations officer
I want to review and approve or reject reports 
So that only valid reports are processed further.
constraints: Rejected reports must include an explanation. If accepted, the report is assigned to the technical office bound to the report category.
expected_behaviors: only valid reports are processed further

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to see approved reports on an interactive map 
So that I can know about issues in my area and beyond.
constraints: Map should be zoomable. When zooming out, reports can be grouped into a cumulative report for a better visualization (total number should be reported on the cumulative report). When zooming in,  reports can be seen separated, with their title and reporter name (or "anonymous" if this is flagged on that report).
expected_behaviors: I can know about issues in my area and beyond

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to choose whether to make my report anonymous 
So that my name is not shown in the public list of reports.
constraints: Anonymous option protects privacy. Choice made at issue description time.
expected_behaviors: my name is not shown in the public list of reports

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member
I want to see the list of reports assigned to me
So that I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done
expected_behaviors: I can get an overview of the maintenance to be done

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to configure my account
So that I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence.
constraints: Citizens can  upload a personal photo, add their Telegram username and switch off/on email notifications in the configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can better manage notifications and my virtual presence

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user 
I want to search for reports in a specific area by typing in an address
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area.
constraints: You can choose how much to zoom in. The product owner will then provide feedback on the implementation.
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports in that specific area

requirements.text:
As a system administrator
I want to modify roles to municipality users
So that the staff can be more flexible.
constraints: This story overwrites a previous answer given by PO on the Telegram chat. NB: 1) A municipality user can now have multiple roles, i.e. serving on more than one technical office. 2) Modification includes cancellation.
expected_behaviors: the staff can be more flexible

requirements.text:
As a technical office staff member 
I want to update report statuses 
So that citizens are informed of the problem resolution process.
constraints: At each status change, the citizen receives notification in the platform with the corresponding update. Municipal operators working on reports can also send messages to the citizens in the platform, to which the citizen can reply.
expected_behaviors: citizens are informed of the problem resolution process

requirements.text:
As a citizen
I want to create a new report through a Telegram bot
So that I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area.
constraints:
Allows the citizen to open a new report by selecting a location on the Turin map, entering a title, description, choosing a category, and attaching up to three photos. The bot also asks if the report should be anonymous.

Example command:

/newreport → Starts the guided process to create a new issue report with location, title, description, category, photos, and anonymity preference.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly notify the public administration about an issue in my area

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to check my report status through a Telegram bot 
So that I can quickly get updates.
constraints:
Check the status of their own reports, receiving an updated list with any changes.
Example commands:

/myreports → Lists all your submitted reports with their current status.

/reportstatus 12345 → Shows details and current status of report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I can quickly get updates

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to access quick assistance and help commands from the Telegram bot 
So that I can understand how to use the system and find useful contacts.
constraints:
Example commands:

/help → Lists available commands and how to use them.

/contact → Provides contact info for the Municipality support team.

/faq → Shows frequently asked questions
expected_behaviors: I can understand how to use the system and find useful contacts

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to reply to messages from municipal operators in the platform 
So that I can communicate directly about my report.
constraints: Two-way communication is possible within the platform.
expected_behaviors: I can communicate directly about my report

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to follow reports done by other citizens 
So that I can be updated
constraints: Only not closed reports can be followed. Notifications follow the  the same rules as for owned reports.
expected_behaviors: I can be updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive real-time push notifications via the Telegram bot 
So that I know instantly when my report status changes.
constraints:
Example commands:

/subscribe → Enable real-time notifications for all your reports.

/unsubscribe → Disable notifications.

/subscribe report 12345 → Subscribe only to updates for report ID 12345.
expected_behaviors: I know instantly when my report status changes

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to receive optional email alerts in addition to platform notifications 
So that I can choose the best way to stay updated.
constraints: Unless disabled in their configuration panel.
expected_behaviors: I can choose the best way to stay updated

requirements.text:
As a citizen /unregistered user
I want to see public statistics about reports 
So that I understand trends in city issues.
constraints: Public statistics  (visible on the site) include the number of reports by category and trends by day, week, or month.
expected_behaviors: I understand trends in city issues

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator 
I want to see detailed private statistics 
So that I can monitor usage and performance of the system.
constraints:
Private statistics (for administrators only), in addition to public ones, also include charts and tables about:  
  - number of reports by status  
  - number of reports by type  
  - number of reports by type and status  
  - number of reports by reporter  
  - number of reports by reporter and type  
  - number of reports by reporter, type and status  
  - number of reports by the top 1% of reporters, by type  
  - number of reports by the top 5% of reporters, by type
expected_behaviors: I can monitor usage and performance of the system

requirements.text:
As a municipal administrator
I want to configure automatic assignment of all reports in a certain category
So that interventions will be faster.
expected_behaviors: interventions will be faster

requirements.text:
As a citizen/unregistered user
I want to browse a summary table of reports with filters 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: Filters: by category, status, period of time
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

requirements.text:
As a citizen 
I want to download the summary table of reports 
So that I can easily explore and analyze existing reports.
constraints: If a filter is active on the table view, only filtered data should be downloaded
expected_behaviors: I can easily explore and analyze existing reports

domain_rules: Reports must be in 'Pending Approval' state until the Organization Office performs preliminary verification.
Accepted reports move to 'Assigned'; Rejected reports require a mandatory explanation from the Municipality Organization Office.
Once approved and accepted, reports are assigned to the competent technical office based on the problem category.
After approval, accepted reports immediately become visible on the Participium portal (map and table).
Unregistered users can view reports on maps and search by address; previously only authenticated users could view reports.
An anonymous user's name is visible to staff but hidden in the public map/list of reports for citizens.
Once a report has been inserted, it cannot be modified or deleted by the citizen.
External maintainers are added by the system administrator and must have their own individual account.
Only technical office staff members can have multiple roles.
Roles 'municipal public relations officer' and 'municipal administrator' are automatically associated with the Organization Office.
Notifications/messages can be set to either real-time or on page refresh depending on preference.
Public statistics include number of reports by category and trends by day/week/month.
Private statistics (admin only) include additional breakdowns: by status, type, reporter, combinations, and top 1%/5% reporters.
Automatic assignment of all issues of a certain category is possible only if previously set by the municipal administrator.
Case 1 (External maintainer has access): Internal comments are report-specific and reserved (not visible to reporter).
Case 2 (External maintainer no access): Communication happens outside Participium; technical office updates status manually.
edge_cases: User attempts to submit a report without registering: System blocks submission.
User attempts to view reports without registration: Previously blocked, now allowed for unregistered users (Sprint 4).
Confirmation code expires after 30 minutes: Account remains inactive until re-registration or new code request.
Citizen tries to modify/delete a submitted report: System denies action.
Report rejected without explanation: System enforces mandatory explanation field.
Zooming out on map beyond threshold: Reports group into cumulative view with total count.
Filter applied to table view then download initiated: Only filtered data is exported to CSV.
External maintainer resolves report in Participium (Case 1): Status updates to Resolved; internal comments remain hidden from reporter.
External maintainer resolves report outside Participium (Case 2): Technical office staff member must manually move status to Resolved.
User follows a closed report: System prevents following or shows 'unfollow' option only for open reports.
assumptions: The 'Organization Office' refers to the central municipal body responsible for initial review and assignment logic.
Competent technical office is determined by the problem category (e.g., Public Lighting -> Enel X or specific office).
Telegram bot integration requires the user to have provided a valid Telegram username in their configuration panel.
Email notifications are sent unless explicitly disabled in the user's configuration panel.
The 'top 1% of reporters' and 'top 5%' statistics are calculated based on the number of reports submitted by each reporter.
External maintainers without access to Participium (Case 2) do not receive push notifications or platform messages regarding their assigned tasks.
